units.source_text: 僧都笑道：“这个梦做得很蹊跷！

en.t: The bishop laughed and said, "That was a very strange dream!

units.source_text: 承公子下问，理应如实奉答，但恐听了扫兴。

en.t: Since you have asked me, my lord, I ought to answer truthfully, but I fear it may dampen your spirits.

units.source_text: 那位按察大纳言已经故世多年了。

en.t: That Inspector Grand Counselor passed away many years ago.

units.source_text: 公子恐怕不认识这个人吧。

en.t: You probably do not know the man, my lord.
His wife is my younger sister.

units.source_text: 大纳言故世之后，这妹妹便出家为尼。

en.t: After the Grand Counselor died, this sister of mine took vows and became a nun.

units.source_text: 近来她患病，因我不住京城，闲居在此，她便来依靠，也在此间修行。”

en.t: Recently she fell ill, and because I am not living in the capital but staying here in retirement, she came to rely on me and is also practicing here."

units.source_text: 公子又揣度着问：“听说这位按察大纳言有个女儿，她现在……啊，我并非出于好奇之心，却是正经地探问。”

en.t: The young lord then ventured to ask, "I have heard that this Inspector Grand Counselor had a daughter. She is now... Ah, I do not ask from idle curiosity, but in all seriousness."

units.source_text: 僧都答道：“他只有一个女儿，死了也有十来年了吧。

en.t: The bishop replied, "He had only one daughter, and she must have been dead for about ten years now.

units.source_text: 大纳言想教这女儿入宫，所以悉心教养，无微不至。

en.t: The Grand Counselor wanted to send this daughter to court, so he raised and educated her with the utmost care.

units.source_text: 可惜事与愿违，大纳言就此去世。

en.t: Unfortunately, things did not go as he wished, and the Grand Counselor died before it could happen.

units.source_text: 这女儿便由做尼姑的母亲一人抚养长大。

en.t: The daughter was then raised by her mother alone, who had become a nun.

units.source_text: 其间不知由何人拉拢，这女儿和那位兵部卿亲王[\[10\]](#part1334.html#m10)私通了。

en.t: In time, through some unknown go-between, the daughter entered into a secret relationship with His Highness the Minister of War[\[10\]](#part1334.html#m10).

units.source_text: 可是兵部卿的正夫人出身高贵，嫉妒成性，屡次谴责，百般恐吓，使这女儿不得安居，郁郁不乐，终于病死了。

en.t: But the Minister of War's principal wife was of noble birth and fiercely jealous by nature; she repeatedly reproached and threatened the young woman in every way, leaving her no peace, until she sank into misery and finally died of illness.

units.source_text: ‘忧能伤人’这句话，我在亲身见闻中证实了。”

en.t: I have seen with my own eyes that the saying, 'Sorrow can wound a person,' is true."
